stdout:
Usage: skilllint docs latest [OPTIONS] {page_name}

  Find the most recent cached file for a page name.
  
  Prints the file path to stdout when found.
  
  Exit status:
      1 when no cached file exists for the given page name.

Arguments:
  page_name  Filesystem-safe page name to look up (e.g. 'claude-code--settings').  [required]

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
